pre_mortem: Spears' over loses if his modest carry role disappears, NYG improves its run defense, or TEN falls behind and substitutes passing opportunities for rushing attempts. Four carries would still require adequate efficiency; his two-game average cannot guarantee that. Ayomanor's over loses if his 80 yards were concentrated in one game or one long play, if his routes decline, or if TEN feeds Tate, Robinson and Helm while running successfully. NYG's supplied pass-defense numbers do not establish a special Ayomanor matchup, making that the weaker read. Neither candidate has verified health or game-level role stability, so both remain leans.
slip_story: A competitive TEN offense generates enough rushing opportunity for Spears and selective downfield completions for Ayomanor. Spears survives the base case and TEN-leading flip; Ayomanor survives the base case and NYG-leading flip, but a low-volume TEN blowout threatens him. These are two watchlist candidates, not a completed 3–4-leg slip; do not manufacture additional legs or assume their joint probability is the product of independent chances.
